label: H.R. 10371
title: Ensuring SBA Implementation of GAO Recommendations Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill requires the Office of Veterans Business Development within the Small Business Administration (SBA) to develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure compliance with existing reporting requirements related to veteran-owned small businesses.

This bill requires the Office of Veterans Business Development within the Small Business Administration (SBA) to develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure compliance with existing reporting requirements related to veteran-owned small businesses.

This bill requires the Office of Veterans Business Development within the Small Business Administration (SBA) to develop and implement policies and procedures to ensure compliance with existing reporting requirements related to veteran-owned small businesses.
Specifically, such policies must ensure the SBA complies and submits an annual report on the needs of small businesses owned and controlled by veterans, including service-disabled veterans.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

M001229.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
M001229.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
M001229.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
